sources.title: openeurollm/tokenizer-128k · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: OpenEuroLLM Tokenizer (128k) A 131,072-token SentencePiece BPE tokenizer designed for efficient tokenization across all EU official languages and additional European languages. Trained on 173 GB of curated multilingual text from the OpenEuroLLM data catalogue on LUMI HPC. This is the compact variant — half the vocabulary of the 262k version with only ~9% higher fertility. sources.title: OpenEuroLLM
sources.snippet: Our colleague from the University of Oslo, Stephan Oepen, presented the OpenEuroLLM project goals and current status at the 2nd International Workshop on Open Source Sovereign Foundation Models (OSFM), which brought together experts to discuss strategies for promoting AI innovation and digital sovereignty in Europe through open and transparent models.

sources.title: OpenEuroLLM GLM-5 Reproduction Guide - GitHub
sources.snippet: The goal is not merely to train a large model. The goal is to build an auditable, extendable, multi-workstream plan that lets OpenEuroLLM teams train, evaluate, release, and iterate on a GLM-5-class open model with European language coverage and European transparency requirements.
